```{r}
assert_file <- function(file, label = "Input file") {
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    stop(label, " not found: ", file)
  }

  invisible(file)
}


assert_directory <- function(directory, label = "Input directory") {
  if (!dir.exists(directory)) {
    stop(label, " not found: ", directory)
  }

  invisible(directory)
}


as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) {
    return(replace(x, is.na(x), FALSE))
  }

  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    return(!is.na(x) & x != 0)
  }

  tolower(trimws(as.character(x))) %in%
    c("true", "t", "1", "yes", "y")
}


fdr_to_stars <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
    x <= 0.001 ~ "***",
    x <= 0.01 ~ "**",
    x <= 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  )
}


normalise_group <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))

  x <- recode(
    x,
    "MSI_H" = "MSI-H",
    "MSS_TMB_H" = "MSS/TMB-H",
    "MSS_TMB_L" = "MSS/TMB-L",
    .default = x
  )

  factor(
    x,
    levels = c(
      "MSI-H",
      "MSS/TMB-H",
      "MSS/TMB-L"
    )
  )
}


read_feature_table <- function(
    file,
    feature_name = "pre_miRNA"
) {
  assert_file(file)

  x <- read.csv(
    file,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  candidates <- c(
    feature_name,
    "pre_miRNA",
    "pre_mirna",
    "miRNA",
    "mirna",
    "Gene",
    "gene",
    "X",
    "...1"
  )

  found <- candidates[
    candidates %in% names(x)
  ]

  if (length(found) > 0) {
    names(x)[
      names(x) == found[1]
    ] <- feature_name
  } else {
    if (ncol(x) < 2) {
      stop(
        "Could not identify the pre-miRNA column in: ",
        file
      )
    }

    names(x)[1] <- feature_name
  }

  x[[feature_name]] <- trimws(
    as.character(x[[feature_name]])
  )

  x <- x[
    !is.na(x[[feature_name]]) &
      nzchar(x[[feature_name]]),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  as_tibble(x)
}


save_placeholder_svg <- function(
    file,
    title,
    detail
) {
  p <- ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.12,
      label = title,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 5
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = -0.12,
      label = detail,
      size = 4
    ) +
    xlim(-1, 1) +
    ylim(-1, 1) +
    theme_void()

  ggsave(
    file,
    p,
    width = 7,
    height = 5,
    device = "svg"
  )

  invisible(p)
}


save_venn <- function(
    sets,
    title,
    file,
    high_color
) {
  if (all(vapply(sets, length, integer(1)) == 0)) {
    save_placeholder_svg(
      file,
      title,
      "No bootstrap-validated pre-miRNAs"
    )

    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  p <- ggVennDiagram(
    sets,
    label_alpha = 0
  ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "white",
      high = high_color
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      )
    )

  ggsave(
    file,
    p,
    width = 6.5,
    height = 5.5,
    device = "svg"
  )

  invisible(p)
}
```

```{r}
read_stability_table <- function(
    stability_file,
    stability_flag_column
) {
  stability <- read_feature_table(
    stability_file,
    feature_name = "pre_miRNA"
  )

  contrast_candidates <- c(
    "Contrast",
    "contrast",
    "Comparison",
    "comparison"
  )

  contrast_column <- contrast_candidates[
    contrast_candidates %in%
      names(stability)
  ]

  if (length(contrast_column) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No contrast column was found in: ",
      stability_file
    )
  }

  names(stability)[
    names(stability) == contrast_column[1]
  ] <- "Contrast"

  if (!stability_flag_column %in% names(stability)) {
    stop(
      "Stability column '",
      stability_flag_column,
      "' was not found in ",
      stability_file,
      ". Available columns: ",
      paste(names(stability), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  duplicates <- stability %>%
    count(
      Contrast,
      pre_miRNA,
      name = "n"
    ) %>%
    filter(n > 1)

  if (nrow(duplicates) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Duplicate Contrast/pre_miRNA rows were found in: ",
      stability_file
    )
  }

  stability %>%
    mutate(
      bootstrap_stable_flag =
        as_flag(
          .data[[stability_flag_column]]
        )
    )
}


build_bootstrap_validated_results <- function(
    dataset,
    primary_directory,
    stability_file,
    output_directory
) {
  assert_directory(
    primary_directory,
    paste0(dataset, " primary result directory")
  )

  stability <- read_stability_table(
    stability_file,
    params$stability_flag_column
  )

  all_output_dir <- file.path(
    output_directory,
    "all_with_stability"
  )

  validated_output_dir <- file.path(
    output_directory,
    "validated_only"
  )

  dir.create(
    all_output_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  dir.create(
    validated_output_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  results <- list()
  summaries <- list()

  for (contrast_name in contrast_names) {
    primary_file <- file.path(
      primary_directory,
      paste0(
        contrast_name,
        ".csv"
      )
    )

    primary <- read_feature_table(
      primary_file,
      feature_name = "pre_miRNA"
    )

    required_columns <- c(
      "logFC",
      "PValue",
      "FDR"
    )

    missing_columns <- setdiff(
      required_columns,
      names(primary)
    )

    if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
      stop(
        "Primary result is missing columns in ",
        primary_file,
        ": ",
        paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
      )
    }

    primary <- primary %>%
      mutate(
        Contrast = contrast_name,
        .before = 1
      )

    stability_for_contrast <- stability %>%
      filter(
        Contrast == contrast_name
      )

    joined <- primary %>%
      left_join(
        stability_for_contrast,
        by = c(
          "Contrast",
          "pre_miRNA"
        ),
        suffix = c("", "_stability")
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        bootstrap_assessed =
          !is.na(bootstrap_stable_flag),

        bootstrap_stable =
          if_else(
            bootstrap_assessed,
            bootstrap_stable_flag,
            FALSE
          ),

        primary_significant =
          !is.na(FDR) &
          FDR <= params$fdr_cutoff &
          !is.na(logFC) &
          abs(logFC) >= params$logfc_cutoff,

        validated_significant =
          primary_significant &
          bootstrap_stable
      )

    results[[contrast_name]] <- joined

    write.csv(
      joined,
      file.path(
        all_output_dir,
        paste0(
          contrast_name,
          ".csv"
        )
      ),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    write.csv(
      joined %>%
        filter(
          validated_significant
        ),
      file.path(
        validated_output_dir,
        paste0(
          contrast_name,
          ".csv"
        )
      ),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    summaries[[contrast_name]] <- tibble(
      Dataset = dataset,
      Contrast = contrast_name,
      Features_tested = nrow(joined),

      Primary_significant = sum(
        joined$primary_significant,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      Bootstrap_assessed = sum(
        joined$bootstrap_assessed,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      Bootstrap_stable = sum(
        joined$bootstrap_stable,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      Validated_significant = sum(
        joined$validated_significant,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
  }

  list(
    results = results,
    summary = bind_rows(summaries)
  )
}
```

```{r}
orient_to_mss_tmb_h <- function(
    result,
    contrast_name,
    dataset
) {
  if (
    contrast_name ==
      "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H"
  ) {
    result <- result %>%
      mutate(
        plot_logFC = -logFC,
        comparison =
          "MSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H"
      )
  } else if (
    contrast_name ==
      "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L"
  ) {
    result <- result %>%
      mutate(
        plot_logFC = logFC,
        comparison =
          "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L"
      )
  } else {
    result <- result %>%
      mutate(
        plot_logFC = logFC,
        comparison =
          "MSI-H vs MSS/TMB-L"
      )
  }

  result %>%
    mutate(
      dataset = dataset,

      direction = case_when(
        validated_significant &
          plot_logFC > 0 ~
          "Up in MSS/TMB-H",

        validated_significant &
          plot_logFC < 0 ~
          "Down in MSS/TMB-H",

        TRUE ~
          "Not bootstrap-validated"
      ),

      neglog10FDR =
        -log10(
          pmax(FDR, 1e-300)
        )
    )
}
```

```{r}
plot_validated_volcano <- function(
    data,
    title,
    file
) {
  labels <- data %>%
    filter(
      validated_significant
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      FDR,
      desc(abs(plot_logFC))
    ) %>%
    slice_head(
      n = params$volcano_label_n
    )

  p <- ggplot(
    data,
    aes(
      plot_logFC,
      neglog10FDR
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = direction),
      alpha = 0.75,
      size = 1.6
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(
        -params$logfc_cutoff,
        params$logfc_cutoff
      ),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept =
        -log10(params$fdr_cutoff),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = labels,
      aes(label = pre_miRNA),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = volcano_colors,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle =
        "Colored pre-miRNAs are primary significant and bootstrap stable",
      x =
        "log2 fold-change: MSS/TMB-H relative to comparator",
      y =
        expression(-log[10]("primary edgeR FDR")),
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(
      base_size = 13
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  ggsave(
    file,
    p,
    width = 6.7,
    height = 5.4,
    device = "svg"
  )

  invisible(p)
}
```

```{r}
read_model_expression <- function(
    model_file,
    clinical_file,
    dataset
) {
  assert_file(
    model_file,
    paste0(dataset, " primary edgeR model")
  )

  assert_file(
    clinical_file,
    paste0(dataset, " matched clinical data")
  )

  model <- readRDS(
    model_file
  )

  if (
    is.null(model$y) ||
    !inherits(model$y, "DGEList")
  ) {
    stop(
      dataset,
      " model does not contain a DGEList in model$y."
    )
  }

  expression <- edgeR::cpm(
    model$y,
    log = TRUE,
    prior.count = 1
  )

  clinical <- read.csv(
    clinical_file,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    row.names = 1
  )

  if (
    !"MSI_TMB" %in%
      names(clinical)
  ) {
    stop(
      "MSI_TMB column not found in: ",
      clinical_file
    )
  }

  clinical$MSI_TMB <- normalise_group(
    clinical$MSI_TMB
  )

  common_samples <- intersect(
    colnames(expression),
    rownames(clinical)
  )

  if (length(common_samples) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No common samples between the saved ",
      dataset,
      " edgeR model and clinical file."
    )
  }

  expression <- expression[
    ,
    common_samples,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  clinical <- clinical[
    common_samples,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  list(
    expression = expression,
    clinical = clinical
  )
}


make_expression_long <- function(
    expression_object,
    features,
    dataset
) {
  present <- intersect(
    features,
    rownames(
      expression_object$expression
    )
  )

  if (length(present) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  as.data.frame(
    t(
      expression_object$expression[
        present,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]
    )
  ) %>%
    rownames_to_column(
      "sample"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      MSI_TMB =
        expression_object$clinical[
          sample,
          "MSI_TMB"
        ],

      dataset = dataset
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(present),
      names_to = "pre_miRNA",
      values_to = "logCPM"
    )
}
```

```{r}
crc_expression_object <-

expression_long <- bind_rows(
  crc_expression_long,
```

```{r}
make_validated_annotation <- function(
    result,
    dataset,
    group1,
    group2,
    comparison_order
) {
  result %>%
    filter(
      pre_miRNA %in%
        shared_premir,
      validated_significant
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      dataset = dataset,
      pre_miRNA,
      group1 = group1,
      group2 = group2,
      FDR,
      bootstrap_stable,
      significance =
        fdr_to_stars(FDR),
      comparison_order =
        comparison_order
    )
}

annotation_table <- bind_rows(
  make_validated_annotation(
    crc_mssh_vs_msih,
    "CRC",
    "MSI-H",
    "MSS/TMB-H",
    1
  ),

  make_validated_annotation(
    crc_mssh_vs_mssl,
    "CRC",
    "MSS/TMB-H",
    "MSS/TMB-L",
    2
  ),

  make_validated_annotation(
    ucec_mssh_vs_msih,
    "UCEC",
    "MSI-H",
    "MSS/TMB-H",
    1
  ),

  make_validated_annotation(
    ucec_mssh_vs_mssl,
    "UCEC",
    "MSS/TMB-H",
    "MSS/TMB-L",
    2
  )
)

if (nrow(expression_long) > 0) {
  panel_limits <- expression_long %>%
    group_by(
      dataset,
      pre_miRNA
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      panel_max = max(
        logCPM,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      panel_min = min(
        logCPM,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      panel_range = max(
        panel_max - panel_min,
        1
      ),

      .groups = "drop"
    )

  annotation_table <- annotation_table %>%
    left_join(
      panel_limits,
      by = c(
        "dataset",
        "pre_miRNA"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(panel_max)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      y.position =
        panel_max +
        panel_range *
        (
          0.10 +
          0.16 *
            comparison_order
        )
    )
}

write.csv(
  annotation_table,
  file.path(
    plot_dir,
    "bootstrap_validated_pre_miRNA_boxplot_FDR_annotations.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
boxplot_file <- file.path(
  plot_dir,
  "shared_bootstrap_validated_pre_miRNA_expression_boxplots_CRC_UCEC.svg"
)

if (
  length(shared_premir) == 0 ||
  nrow(expression_long) == 0
) {
  save_placeholder_svg(
    boxplot_file,
    "Shared bootstrap-validated pre-miRNA expression",
    "No shared bootstrap-validated pre-miRNAs were available"
  )
} else {
  p_box <- ggplot(
    expression_long,
    aes(
      MSI_TMB,
      logCPM,
      fill = MSI_TMB
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      outlier.shape = NA,
      width = 0.7,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      alpha = 0.5,
      size = 0.8
    )

  if (nrow(annotation_table) > 0) {
    p_box <- p_box +
      ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
        annotation_table,
        label = "significance",
        xmin = "group1",
        xmax = "group2",
        y.position = "y.position",
        hide.ns = TRUE,
        tip.length = 0.01,
        bracket.size = 0.3,
        size = 3
      )
  }

  p_box <- p_box +
    facet_grid(
      dataset ~ pre_miRNA,
      scales = "free_y"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = boxplot_colors,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(
          0.05,
          0.30
        )
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(
      title =
        "Expression of shared bootstrap-validated pre-miRNAs",
      subtitle =
        "Brackets are shown only for primary-significant, bootstrap-stable comparisons",
      x = NULL,
      y =
        "TMM-normalized logCPM from saved primary edgeR models",
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(
      base_size = 11
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(
        face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 35,
        hjust = 1
      ),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )

  ggsave(
    boxplot_file,
    p_box,
    width = max(
      10,
      1.8 *
        length(shared_premir)
    ),
    height = 7,
    device = "svg",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  p_box
}
```
